scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game (original with hook off vs candidate with hook on), 4984 isolated CPU pairs for the 5 CGenericGameStorage functions, zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, saves unchanged (hashes of the real saves checked before and after), configs restored. NO real I/O: GenericSave/GenericLoad run with everything touching files or the world replaced by traced doubles (patched at the EXE address and at the DLL body; the bench aborts with an error event before patching if a DLL body is not found or two overlap): OpenFileForWriting (0x5D0DD0), OpenFileForReading (0x5D0D20), SaveWorkBuffer (0x5D0F80) and LoadWorkBuffer (0x5D10B0) with scripted flush/reload outcomes (success, failure with and without ms_bFailed, virtual file for GenericLoad), CFileMgr::CloseFile (0x5389D0), CPad::UpdatePads (0x541E50), CCheat::ResetCheats (0x438450), CSimpleVariablesSaveStructure::Construct (0x5D1B80) and Extract (0x5D1EA0), ReportError (inside GenericLoad), DoGameSpecificStuffAfterSucessLoad (0x618E90), the 24 block saves and 24 block loads (CTheScripts::Save ... C3dMarkers::LoadUser3dMarkers) and DoScriptSetupAfterPoolsHaveLoaded (0x5D3390); CPools::Load is scripted false/true. These helpers get NO credit; only the own logic of each function is validated. The 'file' is a std::vector and the 'FILE*' an opaque token; the work buffer is allocated by the open double with the game operator new[] and freed by the function under test (otherwise by the bench after noting work_null). The returned value, ordered trace of outgoing calls with raw arguments, x87 control word and all fixture bytes are compared. Excluded/limits: ReportError blocks 25, 26 and >= 28 (the EXE uses an uninitialised buffer); ms_WorkBufferSize kept at 0xC800 in GenericLoad (with a smaller value the EXE reads past the 5-byte header), its effect covered only in LoadDataFromWorkBuffer-org; work-buffer sizes below 0xC800 are sanitised to pos = kBuf to avoid the EXE's own infinite recursion; the NOTSA branch of GenericLoad (save-version check) is not exercised because the Extract double returns the current version, and the NOTSA block 25/26 names in ReportError are left as deviations. In ReportError the EXE formats with sprintf (0x821BB5, replaced) into a local buffer while the DLL emits the same text through spdlog (captured with a temporary logger sink). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
